```{python}
#| label: fig-modeling-johnson
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "The Johnson counter with its decoder. Every flip-flop loads the output of its neighbor, so the state shifts from `s_q[0]` to `s_q[3]`, and the inverted `s_q[3]` returns to `s_q[0]`. All four outputs drive the decoder. All flip-flops run on `clk_i` with the reset `rst_ni` (not drawn for simplicity), and the multiplexers in front of the D inputs that implement `clr_i` and `en_i` are not drawn, as in @fig-modeling-excl (b)."
#| fig-alt: "Four flip-flops in a row, s_q[0] to s_q[3], each output feeding the D input of the next one. The output of s_q[3] returns through an inverter to the D input of s_q[0]. Each flip-flop output also goes down to a decoder from 4 to 8 bits, whose output is q_o of 8 bits."
import schemdraw as sd
from schemdraw import flow, logic
from schemdraw import elements as elm
sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False

BLUE, BLUE_L = '#6c8ebf', '#dae8fc'
GREEN, GREEN_L = '#82b366', '#d5e8d4'
FW, PITCH = 1.7, 2.7   # width and pitch of the flip-flops
XT = 0.3               # tap of an output, right of its flip-flop
YT, YD = 1.3, -2.4     # feedback above the flip-flops, top of the decoder
XL = 3*PITCH + FW + XT
XS = -0.7              # feedback into the first flip-flop

with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=1, fontsize=11, lw=1.5, bgcolor='white')

    for k in range(4):
        x = k*PITCH
        flow.Box(w=FW, h=2.0).at((x + FW/2, -0.45)).anchor('center').fill(BLUE_L).color(BLUE)
        elm.Label().at((x + 0.25, 0)).label('D', color='black')
        elm.Label().at((x + FW - 0.25, 0)).label('Q', color='black')
        elm.Label().at((x + FW/2, -0.5)).label(f's_q[{k}]', color='black')
        flow.Line().at((x, -0.8)).to((x + 0.3, -1.0)).color('black')   # clock triangle
        flow.Line().at((x + 0.3, -1.0)).to((x, -1.2)).color('black')
        xt = x + FW + XT
        flow.Line().at((x + FW, 0)).to((xt, 0))
        elm.Dot(radius=0.06).at((xt, 0))
        flow.Arrow().at((xt, 0)).to((xt, YD))
        if k < 3:
            flow.Arrow().at((xt, 0)).to((x + PITCH, 0))

    # the inverted output of the last flip-flop returns to the first input
    flow.Line().at((XL, 0)).to((XL, YT))
    inv = logic.Not().left().scale(0.6).at(((3*PITCH + FW)/2, YT)).anchor('center')
    flow.Line().at((XL, YT)).to(inv.start)
    flow.Line().at(inv.end).to((XS, YT))
    flow.Line().at((XS, YT)).to((XS, 0))
    flow.Arrow().at((XS, 0)).to((0, 0))

    dec = flow.Box(w=XL + 0.5, h=1.0).at(((XL + 0.5)/2, YD - 0.5)).anchor('center').fill(GREEN_L).color(GREEN) \
        .label('decoder, 4 to 8', color='black')
    flow.Arrow().at(dec.E).to((dec.E[0] + 1.6, dec.E[1]))
    elm.Line().at((dec.E[0] + 0.7, dec.E[1] - 0.18)).to((dec.E[0] + 0.94, dec.E[1] + 0.18)).color('black').linewidth(1.2)
    elm.Label().at((dec.E[0] + 0.82, dec.E[1] + 0.32)).label('8', color='black')
    elm.Label().at((dec.E[0] + 1.7, dec.E[1])).label('q_o', halign='left', color='black')
```
